series.name: 内六角螺丝系列
series.desc: 圆柱头内六角结构，适用于高扭矩装夹与紧凑空间装配，是精密机械装配的基础紧固件。
series.descEn: Cylindrical socket head design for high-torque clamping in compact spaces — the foundation of precision machine assembly.

series.name: 组合螺丝系列
series.desc: 螺丝与弹垫、平垫预装配成组合件，提升装配效率并保证防松性能，广泛用于批量产线装配。
series.descEn: Pre-assembled screw with spring and flat washers for faster assembly lines and reliable anti-loosening performance.

series.name: 电子小螺丝系列
series.desc: 面向 3C 电子与精密仪器的高精度微型螺丝，涵盖 PA/PB/KA/TA 等自攻与机丝全型号。
series.descEn: High-precision micro screws for 3C electronics and precision instruments — full range of PA/PB/KA/TA tapping and machine types.

series.name: 外六角螺丝系列
series.desc: 覆盖 4.8 – 12.9 全强度等级与钢结构连接副，法兰面、发黑、热浸锌等表面工艺齐全。
series.descEn: Full strength range from 4.8 to 12.9 plus structural connection sets — flange, black oxide and hot-dip galvanized finishes available.

series.name: 垫圈系列
series.desc: 平垫、弹垫、挡圈、异形垫圈全品类覆盖，提供防松、导电、绝缘与载荷分散解决方案。
series.descEn: Complete range of flat, spring, retaining and special washers — anti-loosening, conductive, insulating and load-spreading solutions.

series.name: 螺母系列
series.desc: 六角、法兰面、锁紧、盖型等全品类螺母，另有铜质与铝型材专用滑块螺母等细分型号。
series.descEn: Hex, flange, lock and acorn nuts in full range, plus brass fasteners and aluminum-profile T-slot nuts.

series.name: 压铆系列
series.desc: 压铆螺母、压铆螺钉、松不脱与定位支撑柱，专为钣金与机箱机柜薄板铆装工艺设计。
series.descEn: Press-fit nuts, studs, captive screws and standoffs engineered for sheet-metal and cabinet riveting processes.

series.name: 家装建筑系列
series.desc: 自攻钉、墙板钉、花兰螺丝、钢丝绳夹等建筑装饰与吊装索具用紧固件。
series.descEn: Self-tapping and drywall screws, turnbuckles and wire rope clips for construction, decoration and rigging applications.

series.name: 钻尾螺丝系列
series.desc: 自带钻尾的一次成型自钻自攻螺丝，免预钻孔直接穿透钢板与彩钢瓦，施工效率高。
series.descEn: One-step self-drilling screws that pierce steel plate and color-coated roofing without pre-drilling — maximum installation efficiency.

series.name: 膨胀螺栓系列
series.desc: 拉爆、壁虎、化学锚栓等混凝土锚固方案，覆盖家电安装、电梯、幕墙等高载荷场景。
series.descEn: Wedge, sleeve and chemical anchors for concrete — high-load solutions for appliances, elevators and curtain walls.

series.name: 螺柱牙条牙棒系列
series.desc: 双头螺柱、牙条牙棒、U 型螺栓、地脚螺栓与焊钉，满足长距离连接与预埋焊接需求。
series.descEn: Double-end studs, threaded rods, U-bolts, anchor bolts and weld studs for long-distance connection and embedded welding.

series.name: 销轴螺丝系列
series.desc: 圆柱销、圆锥销、开口销、平键与铆钉，用于定位、连接与防转的高可靠性销轴类零件。
series.descEn: Parallel, taper and cotter pins, parallel keys and rivets — high-reliability positioning and anti-rotation components.

series.name: 弹簧 CNC 车床件非标异形件
series.desc: 弹簧、CNC 车削件与非标异形件来图定制，支持复杂结构一次成型与严格公差控制。
series.descEn: Springs, CNC turned parts and custom specials made to drawing — one-piece forming of complex geometry with tight tolerance control.
